eventDetail.scope: The 2027 9th International Youth Conference on Radio Electronics, Electrical and Power Engineering (REEPE) is an international forum for the exchange of ideas, novelty, and information in the fields of electrical power and energy engineering, signal processing, computer engineering, nuclear engineering, and mechanical engineering, among others. REEPE conference topics include nuclear and mechanical applications, voltage regulation for electricity networks up to 1150 kV, techniques for enhancing dynamic stability in power systems, soft computing applications in power systems, methods for testing overhead power line support, methods for regulating electrical energy, monitoring power quality, and assessing how modern electrical appliances affect the electricity supply system. Further, research interests include Industrial design, Water-Energy and Sustainability, engineering Management, Medical Devices and Diagnostic Engineering, and evaluating the efficiency of power plants.
